original.platform: Windows 11 ARM64 in UTM; unchanged original assembly

scope: Five Excel option combinations and two CSV outputs produced through the original Windows GUI, with the identical SQLite input reopened and read back. Finite synthetic examples; no empirical or universal-equivalence claim.

testcenter.scope: Actual original GUI, sequential fresh administrator sessions, logs before responses; JSON files compared byte for byte. Synthetic seeded reports only. First attempt used an expired session and returned HTTP 403; the fresh run completed.

limitations: Screen observations establish the performed finite gestures. They do not establish every DPI, scale, crop, alias, legacy file or GUI sequence.
